provenance.engine: upstream NanoDet / PyTorch CPU, one thread
provenance.timing_scope: JPEG decode, upstream validation preprocessing, numerical execution and upstream postprocessing; excludes file read

score_semantics: maximum raw person class confidence; 500 classification agrees with accepted person boxes on all samples
limitations: Host screening only; no ESP32-S3 latency, memory or concurrent video FPS measured.
Fixed 0.5 score threshold across uncalibrated models; no claim of an optimized operating point.
COCO/VWW and Open Images tasks are reported separately.
Static image errors are not false alarms/hour or temporal incident recall.
